mainEntity.name: What does a naturopathic doctor do?

acceptedAnswer.text: A naturopathic doctor looks for the root cause of your symptoms and supports the body's own ability to heal. I pair that philosophy with advanced labs and functional medicine, then build a plan from nutrition to targeted support that treats the cause.

Done well, yes. I hold a Ph.D. in Functional Medicine and am board certified in holistic health. My naturopathic care is grounded in advanced lab testing and physiology, not guesswork or supplements alone.

mainEntity.name: How is a naturopathic doctor different from a conventional doctor?

acceptedAnswer.text: A conventional visit usually names a symptom and medicates it. As a naturopathic doctor in Atlanta, I look for what the body is trying to correct, remove what is in the way, and supply what is missing, using the gentlest effective tools first.

mainEntity.name: What does a naturopath in Atlanta treat?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hormones, PCOS, gut and digestion, chronic fatigue, thyroid, hair loss, menopause, and weight. Anywhere the root cause spans several systems is where naturopathic, root-cause care helps most.

mainEntity.name: Do you work alongside my regular doctor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Naturopathic and functional medicine care here is provided alongside, not in place of, your primary and specialty care. We coordinate so the whole picture stays connected.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer virtual naturopathic visits or only in person in Atlanta?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both. See me in person at our Atlanta clinic, or virtually anywhere in Georgia. Your $99 Symptom Consultation can be booked either way.

sections.label: Hero

headings.text: A naturopathic doctor in Atlanta who treats the cause and supports the body.

paragraphs: If you want care that works with your body rather than just silencing it, and a doctor who will actually look for why you feel this way, you are in the right place.

I am Dr. Nina Ross, ND PhD. As a naturopathic doctor I follow a simple principle: find the root cause and give the body what it needs to heal. I pair that with advanced labs and modern functional medicine, here in Atlanta and virtually across Georgia, then build the plan around your body and your life.

imageSlots.alt: Dr. Nina Ross, a naturopathic doctor in Atlanta, with a patient at her functional medicine clinic

sections.label: If this sounds familiar

headings.text: You have been to doctors. You still do not feel heard.

paragraphs: You are not difficult, and you are not imagining it. You have just never been given the time.

sections.label: Meet Dr. Nina

headings.text: The doctor who looks closer and listens longer.

paragraphs: For years I watched people, so many of them women who looked like me, carry symptoms that no one would slow down to explain. So I built the practice I wished they could walk into. One where you are believed first, investigated thoroughly, and treated as a whole person with a life, not a fifteen minute slot.
When someone finally feels seen, the healing has already begun.

sections.label: The naturopathic principle

headings.text: Treat the cause. Support the body's own ability to heal.

paragraphs: Naturopathic medicine starts from a different question: not how do we suppress this symptom, but what is the body trying to correct, and how do we help it. We remove what is in the way, supply what is missing, and let your physiology do what it is built to do.
Your body is not the problem to be silenced. It is the system to be supported.

imageSlots.alt: Dr. Nina Ross, a naturopathic doctor in Atlanta, sitting with a patient

boldPairs.title: Find the root cause
boldPairs.body: We look beneath the symptom for the imbalance driving it, then treat that.

boldPairs.title: Support, do not suppress
boldPairs.body: Care works with your body's own systems instead of just overriding the signal.

boldPairs.title: Least force, most effect
boldPairs.body: We reach for the gentlest effective tools first, and use advanced testing to aim them.

sections.label: What holistic means

headings.text: Naturopathic does not mean unscientific. It means root-cause.

paragraphs: Naturopathic medicine is often mistaken for guesswork or supplements alone. Done well, it is rigorous and lab-driven. I read how every system in your body connects, then choose targeted, evidence-informed care, from nutrition to hormone support, that treats the cause.
This is medicine that respects both your science and your story.

imageSlots.alt: Advanced functional medicine lab work at Dr. Nina Ross's Atlanta clinic

boldPairs.title: Real labs, read for optimal
boldPairs.body: Advanced panels read against where you actually feel well, not just inside a wide normal range.

boldPairs.title: The whole system, connected
boldPairs.body: Hormones, gut, metabolism, and stress are mapped together so the real driver cannot hide.

boldPairs.title: A plan you help build
boldPairs.body: Care shaped around your body and your real life, with you in the room deciding.
